messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a VERSION FREEZE for the model alias `garnet-stable` -> locking to `garnet-3b@v2.1.5` tonight at 22:00 UTC. This is non-emergency but requires coordinated smoke checks and a rollback owner. Quick checklist below, please ack and say which item you’ll own.

maya: Checklist (short):
- run smoke generation (2 prompts + edge cases) in prod-sandbox
- verify latency p50/p95 and error rate on /generate
- watch cost/throughput metrics on the model dashboard
- warm cache (3 sample sessions)
- prepare alias revert script and test it once in staging
- confirm canary traffic ramp plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%)

maya: alias update command (catalog api):
```bash
curl -X POST https://catalog.redwood.internal/v1/aliases/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CATALOG_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"alias":"garnet-stable","target":"garnet-3b@v2.1.5","rollout":{"strategy":"canary","steps":[10,50,100]}}'
```

maya: rollback (quick): run alias update again targeting previous version `garnet-3b@v2.1.4` and force stop canary. Sam, can you be rollback owner?

alex: I can run the smoke generation and keep an eye on latency from 22:00-22:30 UTC. Will post a short pass/fail summary. Also will run the 3 cache warm sessions.

sam: I can take rollback ownership and will be on-call. I’ll test the revert script in staging at 20:30 UTC and drop the result here. If anything goes sideways during the roll I’ll execute revert and ping infra.

li: Staging canary is green on functional tests (link: https://ci.redwood/garnet/staging/last). One note: saw a transient memory bump on cold-start for v2.1.5 (12% over baseline) — not a blocker but worth watching. I'll also watch model-serving logs during the canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled alias update job created by maya for 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z — job id: jb-6821. Notifying participants.

alex: quick question — what's our SLA for rollback decision? 15m after canary step or immediate on any error spike?

maya: Good question. Let's use: immediate if >1% error spike or p95 increases by >200ms compared to baseline. Otherwise, wait up to 15m per step before escalating.

sam: Confirmed. I’ll be ready to revert immediately on that threshold. I'll also post the staged revert command after my staging test.

li: I'll set up a small dashboard watchlist and alert: p95, error-rate, 429s, and token output-errors. Will share the watch links here before 21:45 UTC.

maya: Thanks all — assigning owners: smoke: alex, rollback: sam, monitoring: li. If anyone can't make it, shout now. Otherwise I’ll proceed with the scheduled job. :thumbsup:

alex: :white_check_mark: on my side.

sam: :white_check_mark: will post staging revert run at 20:35 UTC.

li: will post the watch links in 10m.

deploy-bot: Reminder set for 30m before job (21:30 UTC).

maya: Final note — after full rollout, please add a quick line to the model changelog with perf/cost delta. We want a 1-week check-in to validate quality metrics.

alex: Copy that — will add changelog entry.

sam: Thanks, team.
